name: Tilda Publishing
description_en:
Tilda is a hosted page and website builder with block-based editing and paid custom-domain, store and course capabilities. Its Free plan covers one site with a restricted block collection; Personal covers one site with the full advertised features, while Business covers five sites and adds static code export. A website may contain many pages sharing its domain and site-level style.

The important boundary is between publishing on Tilda and exporting files. Business export produces HTML/CSS/JavaScript/media, but several services remain on Tilda, some require a continuing paid subscription, password protection stops, and the documented usage rules restrict editing and redistributing exported code.
description_zh:
Tilda 是使用区块编辑的托管页面及网站构建器，付费提供自定义域名、商店和课程能力。Free 覆盖一个站点及受限区块集合，Personal 覆盖一个站点及广告所述完整功能，Business 覆盖五个站点并增加静态代码导出。一个网站可包含共享域名及站点级样式的多个页面。

关键边界在于 Tilda 上发布与文件导出。Business 可导出 HTML/CSS/JavaScript/媒体，但部分服务仍留在 Tilda、部分要求持续付费，密码保护失效，文档使用规则还限制站外改码和再分发。

core_features.explanation_en: Multiple pages can share a domain and common fonts/colors; independent client domains/styles require separate sites.
core_features.explanation_zh: 多页面可共享域名及字体/颜色，不同客户域名/样式需要独立站点。

core_features.explanation_en: Publishing creates a public share URL; editor URLs are private, and drafts need republishing before visitors see edits.
core_features.explanation_zh: 发布生成公开分享 URL，编辑器 URL 是私有的，编辑后需重新发布访客才能看到。

core_features.name_zh: 带依赖的 Business 静态导出
core_features.explanation_en: Export ZIP files to a declared destination domain; forms/fonts/catalog/feeds can still require subscription and services.
core_features.explanation_zh: 导出 ZIP 到已声明目的地域名，但表单/字体/目录/Feeds 仍可能依赖订阅和服务。

pricing.summary_en: Free one-site/key-block tier; Personal $15/month or displayed $10 monthly equivalent annually, Business five sites/export $25 or $20 equivalent annually. Branding removal annual-only; exported services can still require paid subscription.
pricing.summary_zh: Free 一个站点/核心区块；Personal 逐月 $15、年付月均 $10，Business 五站/导出逐月 $25、年付月均 $20。移除标记要求年付，导出后的部分服务仍需付费订阅。

sections.title_en: Build a site rather than counting every page as a site
sections.title_zh: 构建站点而非将每页都算成网站
sections.en: Choose one site for pages that share a domain and style, such as a studio home, portfolio and campaign article. Separate clients with different domains consume separate site allowances. Edit a page, publish it and use the resulting public URL in menus or messages; the editor address will not work for visitors. Changes remain private until republished. Page Settings → Additional can unpublish or password-protect a page, while site-wide protection lives in Site Settings. Folders can separate drafts from selected publication. Inspect live pages after publishing and refresh if the browser shows cached content.
sections.zh: 工作室首页、作品集和活动文章等共享域名/样式的页面可放在一个站点，不同客户域名则占用独立站点名额。编辑页面后发布，再将生成的公开 URL 用于菜单或消息，编辑器地址访客无法使用。更改需重新发布才公开。Page Settings → Additional 可取消发布或对单页设密码，整站保护在 Site Settings，文件夹可将草稿与选择性发布分开。发布后应检查线上页面，浏览器显示缓存时刷新。

sections.title_en: Compare site count, billing term and branding
sections.title_zh: 比较站点数、周期和品牌显示
sections.en: Free covers one site using key blocks. Personal displays $10/month with annual payment or $15 month-to-month; Business displays $20 annual monthly equivalent or $25 month-to-month and covers five sites with export. Confirm checkout currency code, tax and actual annual charge. The pricing FAQ says removing the Made on Tilda label becomes available with annual Personal/Business subscriptions, so do not assume every monthly paid plan removes it. Personal and Business both advertise store/course tools, but payment processing and individual operational limits were not priced in these sources. Non-renewal unpublishes the hosted site; data remains for six months and is then permanently deleted if not renewed.
sections.zh: Free 覆盖一个站点及核心区块。Personal 年付月均显示 $10，逐月 $15；Business 年付月均 $20，逐月 $25，含五个站点与导出。币种代码、税费和实际年付金额需结账确认。定价 FAQ 将移除 Made on Tilda 标记限定为年付 Personal/Business，不能认为所有月付付费档都移除。两档均宣传商店/课程工具，但这些来源没有列出支付处理及具体运行限额费用。不续费时托管网站取消发布，数据保留六个月，之后未续费将永久删除。

sections.title_en: Choose DNS management or a registrar-side connection
sections.title_zh: 选择 DNS 管理或注册商侧连接
sections.en: The domain guide offers two paths: delegate DNS management to Tilda’s nameservers, or keep DNS management and set the A records specified in Site Settings → Domain. Delegation is a DNS-management change, not proof that domain registration ownership transfers. If using external services on subdomains, the guide recommends considering registrar-side records. Inspect existing mail/TXT/subdomain records before any change, then check Tilda’s connection state and publish the pages. The guide allows up to 24 hours for DNS propagation. This research did not register, transfer or edit any domain.
sections.zh: 域名指南给出两条路径：将 DNS 管理委派给 Tilda nameserver，或保留 DNS 管理并设置 Site Settings → Domain 指定的 A 记录。委派是 DNS 管理变化，不证明域名注册所有权转移。若子域名使用外部服务，指南建议考虑注册商侧记录。任何改动前都应检查原邮件/TXT/子域名记录，再核对 Tilda 连接状态并发布页面。指南允许 DNS 最多 24 小时传播。本次未注册、转移或修改任何域名。

sections.title_en: Do not confuse the ZIP with a complete service migration
sections.title_zh: 不要将 ZIP 等同于完整服务迁移
sections.en: Export requires Business. Set the destination domain in Site Settings, choose Export → Download as ZIP → Start Export, then upload extracted files to the target host. Configure HTTPS separately: Tilda’s free certificate is disabled on exported projects. Forms require an active paid subscription, as do certain library fonts. Page/project passwords stop protecting exported pages. CRM, Members, Product Catalog and Feeds cannot be exported as independent services. Catalog/feed content still needs paid service and the declared domain; direct product/post links are disabled in that export context, and items/posts are unpublished seven days after cancellation. Rebuild or replace these dependencies before relying on an external host.
sections.zh: 导出要求 Business。先在 Site Settings 设置目的地域名，选择 Export → Download as ZIP → Start Export，再将解压文件上传到目标主机。HTTPS 需另外配置，Tilda 免费证书在导出项目中禁用。表单和部分字体库要求持续付费，页面/整站密码不再保护导出页面。CRM、Members、Product Catalog 和 Feeds 无法作为独立服务导出。目录/Feeds 内容仍需要付费及声明域名，导出场景下商品/文章直接链接禁用，取消订阅七天后商品/文章下线。依赖外部主机前应重建或替换这些依赖。

sections.title_en: Export rights are constrained usage rights
sections.en: The export rules prohibit deployment to an undeclared domain, replication/distribution, using exported code to build pages outside Tilda and changing code outside Tilda. Apache htaccess mappings also need manual equivalents on other web servers. Therefore, evaluate export as a constrained deployment route, not an open-source or unrestricted maintenance entitlement. Tilda may suit a content/design team accepting hosted blocks and its service terms. A team expecting to take the code, edit it independently and preserve all membership/store behavior should obtain an explicit alternative agreement or choose a workflow that permits those needs. No editor, checkout, export, form delivery, membership or external-server test was executed.
sections.zh: 导出规则禁止部署到未声明域名、复制/分发、将导出代码用于 Tilda 外建页及站外改码。Apache htaccess 映射在其他服务器还需手动等价配置。因此应将导出视为受限部署路径，不能当作开源或无限制独立维护权利。接受托管区块和服务条款的内容/设计团队可考虑 Tilda。期望取得代码后独立编辑并保留全部会员/商店行为的团队，应获得明确替代协议或选择允许这些需求的流程。本次未执行编辑器、结账、导出、表单投递、会员或外部服务器测试。
